text:
Jules: Who's up for a Saturday afternoon schmooze + quick Skribbl.io round + a samosa run? Thinking rooftop 3pm, grab samosas from the Spice Cart on the corner. :)
Priya: love this. prefer 4pm tho — can we do 4?
Marco: either works for me. I can bring a bluetooth speaker and some card games.
OpsBot: Facilities note: rooftop available Sat 14:00-18:00. Please book a timeslot here: https://intra.redwood/facilities/rooftop (auto-reminder at 12:00 day-of).
Tanya: i'll throw up a quick poll — 3pm / 4pm / evening?
Eli: samosas — veg ok? also can we get a gf option?
Jules: @Priya @Eli good call. I can order 20 samosas: planning 4 GF, 6 vegan, rest regular unless people change.
Priya: thanks Jules! vegan + gf noted. i'll bring napkins and a small first-aid kit (allergy-aware). :heart:
Marco: i'll chip in $10.venmo @marco-redwood. also can someone bring plates?
Jules: @Marco appreciate it. i'll handle plates & cups.
Tanya: poll results so far — 4pm leading, 3pm second. i'll leave it open till friday 10am.
Eli: can we add a quick movie loop on the projector after skribbl? low volume.
Jules: yes projector ok if folks are cool with chill background stuff. maybe one short indie flick or montage.
Priya: vote for 4pm + montage please. :thumbsup:
OpsBot: Note: rooftop occupancy limit 50. Please keep music volume considerate of nearby tenants.
Marco: anyone allergic to peanuts? just checking before ordering.
Eli: not me. @Priya?
Priya: no peanuts for me pls.
Jules: got it — order notes: no peanuts, 4 GF, 6 vegan. final headcount: 12-ish. if you're coming DM me so i can finalize.
Marco: RSVP: yes
Eli: RSVP: yes
Tanya: RSVP: maybe (will confirm by friday)
Priya: RSVP: yes
Jules: cool — i'll place order friday noon. see y'all saturday 4pm on the rooftop! :party_popper:
